day.headline: Meetings bookend the day, Eric — the middle is yours for the three returns.
day.mapCaption: Nearly all the weight is at Kahala — five tax matters, three of them returns to finish before Wednesday — with one item each at Kakaako, Kalihi and Hawaii Kai.

acts.text: A FLOWN session first, then the Reyes follow-up call — the morning has a shape before you open the inbox.
Nothing booked. The returns fit here, Sam's first because his deadline lands while you are at sea.
The Devoted training at four, then an open evening before Tuesday's last full day on land.

events.title: Call Ana Reyes — living benefits follow-up

day.tomorrow: Tuesday opens with nothing booked until noon; you chose to carry Sam's return and the Guam reply.

recommendation.title: Send Sam the e-file authorization tonight
recommendation.why: His return is the only one with a hard deadline before you board, and the signature is the one step that can't happen from the ship.
recommendation.claudeDoes: Draft the 8879 email to Sam and set a reminder for the follow-up.
recommendation.youDo: Review the return totals and press send.
recommendation.prompt: Draft an email to Sam asking him to sign his e-file authorization (Form 8879) tonight, so his return can be filed before I board on Wednesday. Keep it short and warm, in my voice. Then add a QuickAction in Notion to follow up tomorrow morning if he hasn't signed.

kikuyo-return.title: Ask Mia for her missing 1099-R
kikuyo-return.why: Her return can't move until the pension form arrives, and she asked for it as soon as possible.
kikuyo-return.claudeDoes: Draft a short email asking for the 1099-R and add a follow-up task for Friday.
kikuyo-return.youDo: Read it over and send it from the practice address.
kikuyo-return.prompt: Draft a short, warm email from me to Mia Lane asking her to send her pension 1099-R so I can finish her return. Save it as a Gmail draft and add a QuickAction in Notion to follow up Friday.

fpb-guam.title: Call Guam back and set a time
fpb-guam.why: They have asked three times; a fourth ask risks the relationship.
fpb-guam.youDo: Call them and agree a time for the review.

items.title: Sam’s return, finished before you board Wednesday
items.sentence: You put it on the list this afternoon, and his note to the practice address on Saturday still has no answer. The extended deadline is the fifteenth and you are at sea from the seventh, so tomorrow is the last full day on land to close it.
items.sourcePhrase: note to the practice address on Saturday

items.title: Mia Lane’s return, moved up to as soon as possible
items.sentence: The task had sat in Notion since the thirtieth of September; it now reads due today at the top urgency. Her People row notes she is tagged for tax in TaxDome but no 2025 return was found there.

items.title: Theo’s return, with his documents already in
items.sentence: TaxDome showed his e-file request completed on the fifteenth of September, and the new task in Notion is due today.

items.title: Lea is still waiting to hear why her refund was short
items.sentence: Her question has sat unanswered since last Monday evening — the state refund landed about two thousand dollars under what the return showed.
items.sourcePhrase: has sat unanswered since last Monday evening

items.title: Guam has asked a third time for a time to call
items.sentence: The last two messages arrived on Wednesday asking for a date and a convenient time, and nothing has gone back.

items.title: The card behind your practice email was declined
items.sentence: Google wrote on Thursday that the bank declined the payment for the barayugacpa.com account. That domain carries your practice mail while you travel.

items.title: Open enrolment starts while you are at sea
items.sentence: The season opens on the fifteenth, ten days out, and you are on the ship from Wednesday until the eighteenth.

items.title: Eight convention choices need ranking, and nobody has the deadline
items.sentence: The ranking table in Notion is still empty and the deadline still unrecorded.

items.title: Ken’s exit node is shared with you
items.sentence: Your brother shared his device over Tailscale this morning.

items.title: A Stripe payout lands today
items.sentence: Stripe sent word this morning that the payout of $310.99 is expected to arrive today.
